वचि is the substitute of ब्रू 'to speak' when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be supplied.

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

Instead of the first 5 tense-affixes in the लट् (Present Tense) coming after the verb ब्रु 'to speak' there may optionally be the affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) ; आह being at the same time the substitute in the room of ब्रु 'to speak'.

Terms: लट्

Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, the augment इट् is placed after ब्रू।

Terms: इट् augment

In a sacrificial work, the first syllable of 1. ब्रूहि 2. प्रेष्य 3. श्रौषट् and 4.आवह is प्लुत।

Terms: प्लुत
